title: Stereo Camera Calibration
description:
Implemented Stereo Camera Calibration without OpenCV's Inbuilt Function.

  • Done Without OpenCV's in-built method
  • Uses Zhang's Method for Monocular Calibration
  • Dataset contains 20 images each from left and right camera of a chessboard of Square Size 30mm and 11x7 (corners)
  • RMS error 2.306 px as compared to OpenCV's 14.1364 px

title: Vision Transformer in Equinox
description:
Implemented Vision Transformer from Scratch in Equinox

  • Orbax used for checkpointing ar regular intervals
  • Almost 80% accuracy on CIFAR-10 dataset.

title: Surface Reconstruction of Stanford Bunny
description:
ICP Registration and Poisson Surface Reconstruction on Stanford Bunny Dataset

  • Custom Recovery method with Fallback to FPFH and custom Loss Metric (Fitness/RMSE)
  • Poisson Surface Reconstruction for watertight mesh

title: TensoRF implementation in Equinox
description:
Implementation of TensoRF research paper in Equinox (An improvement of base Neural Radiance Fields)

  • Achieved 32+ dB PSNR (2 dB more than original paper)
  • Device Used : Kaggle's TPU v5-8
  • Time Taken : 1 hr 30 min (apx)
  • Dataset : Mic class of NeRF synthetic dataset

title: Convolutional Neural Network From Scratch
description:
Implemented Convolutional Neural Network from Scratch:

  • Used Cupy for GPU acceleration
  • Dataset : CIFAR-10
  • Training Time : 6.5 mins (apx)
  • Accuracy : 66% (without Augmentation, with only SGD for optimization)
